verdict.rationale: Rippling describes a unified platform with APIs for building custom apps, backed by developer documentation, a sandbox environment, a machine-readable llms.txt on developer.rippling.com, and an official CLI for building and deploying integrations. Together these show a documented programmatic surface. missing for 10: evidence of which product operations the API covers (e.g., payroll, HR records), whether access is open to customers or limited to partner app developers, auth and endpoint reference details, and independent hands-on corroboration.
